metaDescription: Discover five Nuttime crunchy spreads, from pistachio to coconut. Explore the flavours, ingredients and your next favourite.
heroBody: Crunchy texture. Big flavour. Pure Nuttime.
secondBody: Pistachio, hazelnut, almond, peanut and coconut. A different character in every jar; a crunchy texture in every spoonful.
ritualBodies: The distinctive flavour of coconut, in a Nuttime spread made with 42% coconut.
Discover the crunchy texture. Enjoy it at breakfast, with dessert or during a little break in your day.
Spread it on toast, add it to pancakes or use it in a favourite recipe. Enjoy it your way.
editorialBody: Sometimes all you need is a little time with a flavour you love. Open the jar and enjoy every crunchy spoonful.
insideHeading: KNOW THE FLAVOUR. EXPLORE THE INGREDIENTS.
productBody: Discover Nuttime at breakfast, in desserts or in your favourite recipe.
ingredientTexts: **Pistachios** (42%), beet sugar, **whole milk powder, whey powder**, vegetable oil (cottonseed), emulsifier (sunflower lecithin). May contain traces of **peanuts, almonds and hazelnuts**.
**Coconut** (42%), beet sugar, **whole milk powder, whey powder, hazelnuts, almonds**, vegetable oil (cottonseed), emulsifier (sunflower lecithin). May contain traces of **peanuts and pistachios**.
